annotations.title: Write a timed short-video script (TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts) with SRT subtitles (AI)

description: Turn an article, notes or product description into a 15/30/45/60-second vertical-video script: hook first, then beats with voiceover, on-screen text and a shot description (usable as a text-to-video prompt), plus title, caption, up to 5 hashtags and SRT subtitles. Timed from speaking rate and trimmed to fit (+10%). No video or voice is generated. A failed generation is not charged. PAID: $0.020 per call in USDC on Base via x402 over MCP, or from prepaid credits if this server is configured with an Authorization: Bearer tkc_... header (see payment_options).

lang.description: Language of voiceover, on-screen text, title and caption: auto = same as the source (default), or en, zh, zh-TW, ja, ko, es, fr, de, pt, ru, id, vi, tr, it. Shot descriptions are in English.

platform.description: tiktok (default), reels (Instagram Reels) or shorts (YouTube Shorts)

text.description: Source to turn into a script: article, notes or product description (100-3000 characters)
